title: Chief Innovation Officer Mike Gadsby on roadmapping
excerpt: O3's Chief Innovation Officer, joined the voices of many industry leaders in this Mind the Product piece about effective roadmapping practices.

featuredImage.alt: Mike Gadsby, co-founder and Chief Innovation Officer.

children.text: , O3’s Chief Innovation Officer, joined the voices of many industry leaders in this Mind the Product piece about effective roadmapping practices. Mike summed it up precisely: “The roadmap needs to equally represent insight from strategy (what do people need), marketing (what do people want), UX/CX (what do people experience) and technology (can it be built efficiently and effectively) to drive product success.”
Use this resource-rich article to brush up on your roadmapping skills

“A roadmap should be a strategic, visual document for high-level communication and discussion of the product vision and intended steps to arrive at this vision.”
– Mike Gadsby, Chief Innovation Officer

seo.description: Mike Gadsby talks about roadmaps representing insights from strategy, marketing, UX/CX and technology to drive product success.
